summary: Playbooks and tasks run top to bottom; each play needs a host pattern and at least one task. Recommends FQCNs (2.10+) to pick the right module.
questions: In what order do plays and tasks run?
What does a play need at minimum?
Why should I use fully qualified collection names for modules?

answer_card.title: Playbook execution order and FQCNs
answer_card.answer_md:
Plays run top to bottom, and tasks inside each play run top to bottom. Each play needs at least a **host pattern** and **one task**.

On Ansible 2.10+, use **FQCNs** (e.g. `ansible.builtin.user`), since multiple collections can have modules with the same name.
